notes.title: We haven’t stopped for breath… and neither have the winds 😉.
notes.notes: [p] It’s been a while since our last update, but in the workshop of [i]Whisper of the Swallows[/i], we’ve been forging, coding, testing… without pause.[/p][p][/p][p]💬 [b]Your feedback on the demo?[/b] We went through it all: difficulty levels tuned, improved onboarding for the first steps, and plenty of other optimizations to make the experience smoother.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ [b]And that’s not all:[/b] a complete UI overhaul, inventory sorting and merging, Steam Cloud saves, Steam achievements, performance boosts… and most importantly, a ton of new content to make the world feel more alive than ever.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The wind is rising… and the adventure draws near. 🌊🗡️[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A few snapshots :[/p][p]You asked for it: the difficulty is now better balanced, and you can choose your level before even setting foot in the world :[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309282/82d3d561b9a0fb4f3e1315cde6f15f3f12bc587d.png"][/img][/p][p]The interface has had a complete makeover: clearer, more user-friendly, enhanced with new icons and a host of improvements :[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309282/18094008f316bf53ef7da60898d83f034788abab.png"][/img][/p][p]Luring a Tengu away by passing near a goat? You wouldn’t dare…[/p][p]And what if, in Unchū, some caves hid rich metal veins?[/p][p]And these portals… how do you release them, and what really happens once they’re open?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309282/46ab238d02d75f83c9b119604e72ed31fe517c2d.png"][/img][/p][p]And this is only a tiny part of what awaits you. The rest? You’ll discover it soon…[/p][p][/p][p]Duc[/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is over 😭
notes.notes:
Steam Neo Fest is already over and the demo has been deactivated 😭
A big thank you to everyone who tested the game, and especially to those who gave us feedback. (For those who used the in-game interface, we can't get back to you, but we've received and taken note of your remarks 👍)

In the end, you were 876 unique players from 23 countries 🤩
Surely numbers that would make well-known studios smile, but for us it's huge, and we didn't expect so much for our first public demo without publisher support.

We've received a lot of positive feedback, with many of you finding the concept and atmosphere interesting!
There was also some negative feedback, mainly on the game's difficulty and balance.
There were no major technical problems. The technical engine has proved its worth in single-player and multiplayer (although we still have work to do on performance and minor bugs)

Based on your feedback, our priority now is to improve the game's balance, allowing players to customize the difficulty. In addition to a busy roadmap, that we hope will bring plenty of surprises and fun.

Once again, thanks to all
We'll be proposing a new event in a few months' time
We'll also be announcing an early release date as soon as we know what the plan is.

Duc

notes.title: Steam Next Fest: 1 week to test the free demo
notes.notes:
Good news!

Whisper of the Swallows will be part of the Steam Next Fest event from February 24, 2025 to March 3, 2025.
We can't wait to let you discover our first public demo 😀
The demo will be deactivated at the end of the event so don't miss out!

Duc
